name: Buzzbox 323
summary: Buzzbox 323 is the third task in a field-research line along the coast of Darkshore, commissioned through a speaker device by the eccentric gnome engineer Wizbang Cranktoggle. Players must gather Moonstalker fangs from local predators and deposit them into the humming contraption situated north of Auberdine.

sections.title: A Slurred Transmission
sections.body: After operating Buzzbox 411 further south, the voice of the gnomish inventor Wizbang Cranktoggle crackles to life over the speaker. Interspersed with the sounds of heavy drinking and slurred directions, Wizbang directs adventurers north of Auberdine, pointing them to Buzzbox 323 near a road bridge. His research requires six Moonstalker Fangs, harvested from the fierce feline hunters roaming the shrouded forests of Darkshore.

sections.title: Gnomish Field Machinery
sections.body: Approaching Buzzbox 323 reveals a machine that chatters with static and faint muttering even before repairs begin. Once the requested fangs are placed inside its intake hopper, the machine violently rattles to life, noisily pulverizing the teeth to dust. Wizbang's boozy voice promptly resumes over the transceiver, celebrating the delivery before prodding the traveler toward the next machine in his scattered network.

faq.answer: Buzzbox 323 stands alongside the main road north of Auberdine, just near the bridge crossing the local river in Darkshore.

faq.q: Who is speaking through the Buzzbox?
faq.answer: The voice belongs to Wizbang Cranktoggle, a gnome inventor stationed elsewhere in Darkshore who communicates through remote transmitters while heavily indulging in ale.

faq.q: What does Buzzbox 323 do with the fangs?
faq.answer: Upon dropping the Moonstalker fangs inside, internal gears immediately grind them down into fine powder as part of Wizbang's automated biological sampling mechanism.

faq.q: Where can I find Moonstalkers in Darkshore?
faq.answer: Moonstalkers and their runts prowl the shaded woodlands and hills bordering the road both north and south of Auberdine.

faq.q: What quest comes before and after Buzzbox 323?
faq.answer: This assignment follows Buzzbox 411, which required thresher eyes, and directly precedes Buzzbox 525, which sends you to collect grizzled scalps from thistle bears far south along the road.

faq.q: Why does Wizbang sound so incoherent?
faq.answer: Wizbang is thoroughly intoxicated while giving instructions, pausing to search for his ale and taking loud gulps between sentences.

angles.text: Wizbang's remote acoustic communication network showcases typical gnomish engineering flair—even if his personal discipline leaves much to be desired.
While native night elves treat the fierce Moonstalkers with reverent caution, gnomish science reduces their lethal fangs to pulverized machine fuel.
The Buzzbox series demonstrates automated material processing coupled with long-range voice relay, an impressive technical design despite its rough operation.
